gbm_population_evidence.quote: Sub-lobectomy for IDH Wild-type and TERT Promoter Mutant Glioblastoma
The intraoperative integrative diagnosis was IDH wild-type high-grade glioma with TERT promoter mutation.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] The intervention group: The intervention group was to receive frontal, temporal, parietal, and occipital sub-lobotomies that met anatomical criteria. (interventions: Procedure: sub-lobectomy)
[OTHER] The control group: The control group was to receive imaging total resection (T1-enhanced borders) that met RANO criteria. (interventions: Procedure: imaging total resection)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: have newly diagnosed high-grade diffuse adult-type gliomas, and have not received any other treatment besides puncture biopsy.

role_evidence.quote: Not receiving Stupp protocol after surgery.
